race.title: Dandara Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: BLUE IN THE WEST was right back to his best at the end of last season, and he gets the vote in a wide-open handicap. Getaway Theatre could have a big say for her in-form yard, while interesting stable-switcher Midweek Voices needs a close look. Colonial Empire is a lively each-way player. BLUE IN THE WEST (IRE) GETAWAY THEATRE (IRE) MIDWEEK VOICES (IRE)
